title: Fix cache and prediction misses in Target::qargs
notes: The PR documents a VF2 transpilation slowdown and restores prior cache-miss and timing behaviour.

title: Accept rotation gate names in CommutationChecker filters
notes: The gate filter incorrectly rejected valid RX gate pairs after generator normalization.

title: Fix incorrect global phase shift for P and U1 gates in CommutativeCancellation
notes: The pass applied an incorrect −π global-phase adjustment to P and U1 rotations summing to 2π.

title: Fix schedule analysis passes with empty circuits
notes: Empty circuits caused schedule-analysis passes to error despite being trivially schedulable.

title: Avoid panics in Optimize1qGatesDecomposition
notes: Legitimate invalid Python-side inputs triggered a PanicException instead of a handled exception.

title: Fix pickling of SabreSwap
notes: SabreSwap instances with routing targets could not be serialized because RoutingTarget lacked pickle support.

title: Un-provide standard_operation for PyGate
notes: Treating PyGate as a standard gate could discard a non-default control state and produce incorrect downstream behaviour.

title: Check target gates are parameterized in optimize1qgatesdecomposition
notes: The pass selected target operations by name alone even when the matching target gate was invalid for synthesis.

title: Raise exception not panic on bad ConsolidateBlocks input
notes: Malformed ConsolidateBlocks input produced a panic rather than a regular exception.

title: Read timing constraints from target when no backend is provided
notes: Scheduling did not use timing constraints present in the Target when no backend object was supplied.

title: Fix global cache of SynthesizeRZRotations
notes: A global synthesis cache could reuse rotations across incompatible contexts and yield an incorrect synthesized result.

title: Fix non-deterministic ConsolidateBlocks output with fixed transpiler seed
notes: ConsolidateBlocks produced different output despite a fixed transpiler seed.

title: Preserve global phase in Commuting2qGateRouter
notes: Commuting2qGateRouter failed to retain the circuit global phase during routing.

title: Fix excessive global-phase accumulation in UnrollForLoops
notes: UnrollForLoops accumulated global phase excessively while unrolling loop bodies.

title: Fix unsafe symmetric simplification of XXPlusYY in CommutativeOptimization
notes: The symmetric XXPlusYY simplification was unsafe and could change the circuit transformation result.

title: Fix cancellation of CS and CSdg in InverseCancellation
notes: InverseCancellation handled CS and CSdg cancellation incorrectly.

title: Fix forced ConsolidateBlocks decomposition for incomplete bases
notes: Forced ConsolidateBlocks decomposition mishandled incomplete basis specifications and could prevent successful transpilation.

title: Fix ParameterVector global-phase panic in RemoveIdentityEquivalent
notes: ParameterVector input could trigger a global-phase panic in RemoveIdentityEquivalent.

title: Fix commutation checking between two Pauli product measurements
notes: Commutation checking gave an incorrect result for two Pauli-product measurements.

title: Fix synth_qft_line failure for circuits with 32 or more qubits
notes: synth_qft_line failed for circuits containing 32 or more qubits.

title: Fix stale best-DAG update in C transpiler optimization level 3
notes: A stale best-DAG update at optimization level 3 could return a non-best optimized circuit.

title: Fix matrix-size validation in CommutationChecker
notes: CommutationChecker accepted an invalid matrix size instead of validating it safely.

title: Fix synth_clifford_depth_lnn for single-qubit Clifford circuits
notes: synth_clifford_depth_lnn failed on the valid single-qubit Clifford case.

title: Fix HLS qubit tracking for plugin-generated operations
notes: HLS lost correct qubit tracking for operations produced by a plugin.

title: Fix zero-length permutation synthesis overflow
notes: Zero-length permutation synthesis overflowed rather than handling the empty case.

title: Fix incorrect argument passed to generate_unroll_3q in Clifford+T transpilation
notes: Clifford+T transpilation passed the wrong argument to generate_unroll_3q.

title: Respect Target when selecting a non-default UnitarySynthesis plugin
notes: A non-default UnitarySynthesis plugin could be selected without respecting the supplied Target.

title: Fix control-flow qargs handling in BasisTranslator
notes: BasisTranslator handled qargs incorrectly inside control-flow operations.

title: Fix ConsolidateBlocks qubit mapping inside control-flow blocks
notes: ConsolidateBlocks mapped qubits incorrectly within control-flow blocks.

title: Fix DAG push-edge ordering non-determinism
notes: DAG push-edge ordering was non-deterministic.

title: Preserve registers through Python Layout to Rust TranspileLayout conversion
notes: Register information was lost during Python Layout to Rust TranspileLayout conversion.

title: Fix global-phase handling in CommutativeCancellation
notes: CommutativeCancellation mishandled circuit global phase.

title: Do not run VF2PostLayout when an explicit layout is supplied
notes: VF2PostLayout ran even when the user had supplied an explicit layout that should have been retained.

title: Fix Target.py_instruction_supported behavior
notes: Target.py_instruction_supported exposed incorrect API behaviour for instruction support queries.

title: Fix MCX dirty-ancilla qubit accounting in HLS selection
notes: HLS MCX selection accounted for dirty ancillas incorrectly, leading to an unsuitable synthesis choice.

title: Fix CommutativeInverseCancellation for Clifford, control-flow, and non-invertible operations
notes: CommutativeInverseCancellation treated Clifford, control-flow, or non-invertible operations incorrectly.

title: Fix ApplyLayout with empty layout
notes: ApplyLayout did not handle an empty layout successfully.

title: Fix HLS classical-bit mapping from control-flow blocks
notes: HLS mapped classical bits incorrectly when operations originated in control-flow blocks.

title: Fix alignment checks of stretch variables
notes: Alignment validation mishandled stretch variables and rejected or failed on valid timing expressions.

title: Fix subtraction-underflow panic in ConstrainedReschedule
notes: ConstrainedReschedule could panic from subtraction underflow.

title: Initialize ConstrainedReschedule.target unconditionally
notes: ConstrainedReschedule could use an uninitialized Target.

title: Fix ConstrainedReschedule barrier handling
notes: ConstrainedReschedule handled barriers incorrectly, violating their intended scheduling constraint.

title: Add safe shape checking to synth_cz_depth_line_mr
notes: synth_cz_depth_line_mr lacked safe input-shape validation.

title: Fix HighLevelSynthesis for custom gate calibrations
notes: HighLevelSynthesis did not preserve custom gate calibration information.
